caption:
Working from home? The fixed rate is 70 cents for every hour you work from home (2024–25 and 2025–26 returns).

It covers energy, phone, internet, stationery and computer consumables in one rate. You need a record of the actual hours you worked from home for the whole year (a timesheet, roster or diary); estimates aren't accepted. Equipment like a laptop, desk or chair is claimed on top, and anything over $300 is claimed over its effective life.

Save this.
